page.overview:
What is Grossbart Brothers?

The Grossbart Brothers were a trio of Skelliger brothers who murdered, raped, and burned down homes so severely a bounty was put out on them in , drawing the attention of Djenge Frett, a bounty hunter in the area. At the time, the three were camping out in the Grotto on Ard Skellig.

Hegel preferred to fight with a heavy blunt axe.

Manfred preferred to fight with a sword.
